tmdiss.problem: Recycled cathode leach mixes Ni, Co and Mn
tmdiss.design: Scavenger that pulls one cathode metal at a time

nisel.problem: Recycled battery leach: nickel must be pulled away from cobalt and manganese
nisel.design: Binder that picks nickel over cobalt and manganese

cosel.problem: Recycled battery leach: cobalt must be pulled from nickel-rich solution
cosel.design: Binder that picks cobalt over nickel

copolish.problem: Battery-grade nickel sulfate must be polished to ppm cobalt
copolish.design: Polishing binder for trace cobalt in nickel sulfate

feal.problem: Iron and aluminium removal loses nickel and cobalt in the waste cake
feal.design: Binder that removes Fe/Al without losing Ni/Co

fscav.problem: Fluoride from battery binder (PVDF) contaminates leach
fscav.design: Sorbent that removes fluoride from battery leach

mnsel.problem: Manganese must be recovered from battery leach at battery grade
